rules.name: Container Escape via Privileged Pod
rules.description: Kubernetes, container, serverless, and cloud-specific attack detection
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "cloud_native" or Message contains "" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
